text:
Omega x Swatch MoonSwatch Mission to Earthphase – Silver Snowflake (SSX01B701): on sale only when it snows in Switzerland.

Sales start 27 November 2026 at selected Swatch stores and run until 20 March 2027. Price CHF 350 or EUR 400 (per Fratello Watches, 25 November 2026). Black Bioceramic case, 42mm wide, Snoopy dial, a laser-engraved snowflake on each watch.

Would you queue on a snowy day, or wait for the next drop? Tell us below.

Source: Fratello Watches, 25 November 2026; Swatch product page, SSX01B701. Image: Swatch.
